title: Point Dume alien base erased from maps
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Point Dume alien base erased from maps, about unspecified at Point Dume, Malibu, California, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: It's like that Point Doom alien base that they erased or

related.note: Both concern the claimed alien base off Point Dume (Sycamore Knoll); the story asserts a base that was erased from maps, while this telling says there was no base.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, mentions in passing an alien base said to be at Point Dume, a headland in Malibu, California. He says it was erased, apparently meaning from maps, though he gives no further details. He brings it up as an example of a place said to have been hidden from view.
